shortDescription: Perform git 'clone', 'pull', 'acp', and 'pacp' (pull, add, commit and push) operations.

options.name: action
options.description: Git operation to perform - 'clone', 'pull', 'pacp'(Pull + Add + Commit + Push), or 'acp' (Add + Commit + Push)

options.name: add
options.description: List of files under C(path) to be staged. Same as C(git add .). File globs not accepted, such as C(./*) or C(*).

options.name: branch
options.description: Git branch where perform git push.

options.name: comment
options.description: Git commit comment. Same as C(git commit -m). Required if action performs commit (e.g., if action in ['pacp', 'acp'])

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to git executable to use. If not supplied, the normal mechanism for resolving binary paths will be used.

options.name: logging_level
options.description: Parameter used to define the level of troubleshooting output.

options.name: mode
options.description: Git operations are performend either over ssh, https or local. Same as C(git@git...) or C(https://user:token@git...). If not specified, the mode will be set to the scheme implied by the URL.

options.name: path
options.description: Folder path where git repo C(.git/) is located.

options.name: push_option
options.description: Git push options. Same as C(git --push-option=option).

options.name: remote
options.description: Local system alias for git remote PUSH and PULL repository operations.

options.name: token
options.description: Git API token for https operations.

options.name: user_email
options.description: Explicit git local email address. Nice to have for remote operations.

options.name: user_name
options.description: Explicit git local user name. Nice to have for remote operations.
